newsitem.title: USA: Video Update signs purchase agreement.
newsitem.headline: Video Update signs purchase agreement.

text.p: Video Update Inc said Friday it recently signed a definitive purchase agreement to acquire the assets of Video View Ltd, a privately owned chain of 23 video rental stores in Alberta, Canada.
The company said it signed the agreement on December 31.
Completion of the purchase is pending and subject to Canadian regulatory approval.

Effective January 1, Video Update began managing Video View's operations and is receiving fees under a management agreement. These fees are expected to be recognized in the fiscal third quarter ending January 31.

"We are moving quickly to finalize our purchase of Video View," Dan Potter, chairman, said in a statement. "In the meantime, we are actively managing the day-to-day operations of Video View and preparing for its full integration into the Video Update system."
Video Update has 277 video stores in North America of which 249 are corporately-owned and 28 are franchised.
